method: Executed: the real EntityTracker (mn.a(sa), mn.b(sa), mn.a()) with real EntityTrackerEntry objects in its one HashSet for real chickens, items, arrows, snowballs and orbs and an EntityPlayerMP stand-in, added in loadedEntityList order. Per tick a World.updateEntities stand-in sets each entity scripted state at its list index, removes a dead one at its own index (real untrackEntity, which queues the id in the player destroyedItemsNetCache) and runs the player first-thing flush at the player slot (mw.h offsets 74-179, bytecode-read); then the real updateTrackedEntities runs. Packets are recorded as [kind, entity id, fields] in sending order.
